manifest.population: Every measurement occurrence in the first complete post-mint snapshot-bound evidence cursor; every matching proposal-embedded measurement from a complete authenticated proposal cursor; every distinct content-addressed direct measurement record; and every proposal decision surface.
manifest.unit: One measurement occurrence counts once for a missing/malformed formula_version, cross-surface version mismatch, or malformed/unauthorized formula-version consumer. One distinct direct record counts once if absent, malformed, or inconsistent with its occurrence versions. One proposal counts once if formula_version appears in a lifecycle decision block outside measurement receipts.
manifest.wire_rule: the key is always present; null is the declared pre-versioning state; otherwise a positive non-Boolean integer
manifest.consumer_rule: The original no-gate condition is preserved except for the later ratified 0.35.0 prospective commensurability consumer. Its gates=true cell is authorized only when unequal versions are named, held_on repeats formula_version, the comparison verdict/governance effect is held, settlement is withheld/ineligible, and the row does not count toward a verdict. The gating-key reason is keys.formula_version.reason when present, otherwise its current gate_rule alias; held_on continues to expose reason.
manifest.cross_surface_rule: Index and proposal-embedded rows reconcile one-to-one by attempt_id and agree on formula_version. Each distinct manifest direct record exposes the key and its version belongs to the sole version set served by all occurrences of that hash.

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
